item.title: Jury selection begins in Florida for 4 charged in 2021 assassination of Haitian president
item.description: MIAMI (AP) — Jury selection is scheduled to begin Monday in the U.S. federal trial of four men charged in the 2021 assassination of Haitian President Jovenel Moïse. Arcangel Pretel Ortiz, Antonio Intriago, Walter Veintemilla and James Solages are charged with conspiring in South Florida to kidnap or kill Haiti’s former leader, plus related charges. They [...]

item.title: 10-foot great white shark pings off Sarasota County coast
item.description: A great white shark measuring over 10 feet long pinged off the coast of Sarasota County on Sunday.

item.title: 7th soldier killed in Operation Epic Fury identified
item.description: The Department of War named the seventh soldier killed while supporting Operation Epic Fury Monday.

item.title: Margie's Market opens Tuesday in Newtown
item.description: All Faiths Food Bank will celebrate the grand opening of Margie's Market, in Sarasota's Newtown community on Tuesday.

item.title: Gunman shot 2 people before shooting Pasco deputy, sheriff says
item.description: A Pasco County deputy and two civilians were shot by a gunman Thursday, according to Sheriff Chris Nocco.

item.title: Bill that could halt plans for Manatee County cruise port heads to DeSantis' desk
item.description: A bill that could halt plans for a new cruise port in Manatee County is now on its way to the governor's desk.

item.title: Florida woman 'knowingly' lets newborn drown in toilet after giving birth, sheriff says
item.description: A Palm Coast woman was arrested on March 6 after deputies say she allowed her newborn to drown in the toilet after "unexpectedly" giving birth at her home, the Flagler County Sheriff's Office said.

item.title: Florida manatee named Romeo sets world record as oldest manatee
item.description: The Gulfarium in Okaloosa County is celebrating one of its own animals as it sets a new world record.

item.title: Florida mother who let boyfriend beat her 5-year-old son gets 60 years in prison
item.description: A Florida mother who allowed her boyfriend to "repeatedly beat and torture" her 5-year-old son will spend the next 60 years in prison, the Volusia County Sheriff's Office said.
